text_block_list.name: Windy & Teio
text_block_list.text: Nee-hee-hee-hee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Act waaay bossier! Act waaay badder! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Windy & Teio
text_block_list.text: Nee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wondering what on earth happened... I invited her into the Trainer's office to hear her out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Teio has become
Windy-chan's apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She begged me to teach her how to prank!
So I haaaaad no choice but to take her on as my apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Ossu! Teach me something that'll totally blow the Prez's mind, Master!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Never mind the pupil thing... but if I recall, Tokai Teio looked up to Symboli Rudolf—
choice_data_list: Should we really be playing pranks?
Is it really okay to play a prank?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine! The Prez is the one to blame
for ignoring me with all her inspections and work duties!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems they got into a fight.
For now, I decided to watch over them from nearby
to make sure things didn't get out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up! The key to a good prank is being scary!
And the rest is startling 'em good!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "However, for someone like the President, a regular roar just won't cut it!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotta be an extra super scary
and surprising prank, or it won't do!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"This is a super-duper top-secret prank, but since you're my apprentice, I'll make an exception...!
Lend me your ear!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble, mutter, mutter...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're putting whoopee cushions on every chair in the student council room AND scribbling all over the walls!?
As expected, you're on a whole other level, Master!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you can't say that out loud!
Though, heheh, isn't it? Aren't I amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A whoopee cushion is... well, fine, I guess,
but doodling on someone goes beyond a simple prank—I feel like they'd just get mad."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To stop the two of them, who looked entirely capable of actually doing it,
I hurriedly decided to change the subject.
choice_data_list: Instead of playing a prank, you should just make up with her normally.
More importantly, how about making a giant jack-in-the-box?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Make up...?
Wait, Teio, were you in a fight with someone?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's not a fight, okay!
It's just, well, the Prez, she...!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whenever I visit her in the student council room, she brushes me off, and when I invite her to train, she turns me down!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You won't even eat lunch with me!
And our tandem run this morning got scrapped too,
you're totally ignoring me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what!?
You're really going to ignore me that much!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Windy-chan won't allow anyone to do that to her precious apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-You're that mad on my behalf?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Naturally! Windy-chan, as the master, is gonna go give 'em a piece of her mind!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way!?
Wait a second~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Madam President! Roaaar~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy and... Teio...?
What on earth is going on?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, stop, stop,
Master!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, thanks to Shinko Windy,
it seemed the two of them were able to make up (?)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Windy-chan's Trainer!
That's a great idea~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we suddenly had to make
a giant jack-in-the-box.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Listen up, the spring is the most important part of a jack-in-the-box!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm, the spring is the key part of a jack-in-the-box... got it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! It pops out with a boing! The pictures go bam!
And lots of other things go boing, boing, boing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Boing... kaboom...
Boing boing boing...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's right! Windy-chan is gonna show you how it's done, so watch veeeeery closely!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The spring is strong, so make sure to close the lid tight! You try it too, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes! Master!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "—That is correct! While holding that down... Heheh, you have quite the knack for this!"

text_block_list.name: Windy & Teio
text_block_list.text:
I did it!!
It's doooone!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! If it's this big,
even the Pre-zident will be totally shocked!
Thanks, Master!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! H-Hmph!
Well, yeah! Windy-chan is a genius, after all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, if anything else comes up?
You can always ask Windy-chan!
I guess I can make an exception and teach ya!"
